label: She or he

details: Vanilla uses it inside sentences such as 'X will join you if you attend one and [she/he] is available'. Adding |U after it makes the first letter a capital.

label: Short name
summary: The character's short name as the game shows it in its interface texts.
details: Vanilla uses it at the start of sentences such as 'X became the House Y head'. Going by its use next to a 'you are / is' choice for the local player, it may read as 'you' for the player's own character.

label: Short name, no tooltip

label: Short name, bare

label: Short name, never 'you'

details: Going by its name and its use ('Available provinces for X', 'X gets: prestige' in a marriage offer), it keeps the name where the plain short name might say 'you'. Vanilla does not say this outright.

label: Short name, never 'you', plain

details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Short name, never 'you', no tooltip

label: Short name, never 'you', bare

label: Short name's, no tooltip

details: Going by its name and by vanilla's use of the same name on other things ('X joined [Y's] war'), it gives 'Y's' as a name even where the text could say 'my'. Not shown for this exact type.

label: Short name's, never 'my', plain

details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

details: Going by its name and its text return type. Vanilla never uses it, so what the tooltip shows is not known.

label: Skill value
summary: The character's value in one skill, given by the skill's name.
details: Vanilla passes the skill key in quotes: 'diplomacy', 'martial', 'prowess'. It shows the number in the character window and in a battle summary next to the prowess icon.

label: Skill with level

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a skill name in quotes, like `'martial'`

label: Spiritual fulfillment

details: Vanilla writes '.GetName' after it to show the level's name in faith and personal beliefs texts, and the HUD uses it as the data of a part of the screen.

label: Fulfillment level by number

label: Fulfillment level icon

details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Fulfillment level tooltip

details: Going by its name and text return type; vanilla never uses it.

details: Going by its name. Vanilla uses it as the text of a label in the faith window; the game documents nothing more.

details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a part of the HUD and of the personal beliefs window.
